independence_evidence: Published by the Palais de Tokyo, a public contemporary-art centre in Paris ('Le magazine du Palais de Tokyo', KD Presse listing; contents and address 13 avenue du Président Wilson 75116 Paris on https://palaisdetokyo.com/pls-41/). Not a media group or brand customer magazine, but it is an institution's own magazine.
qualifies_reason: Print issues in April and October 2026 and the publisher is a public art institution rather than a media group, though the institutional status should be reviewed.
what_it_is: A French-language contemporary art magazine issued by the Palais de Tokyo with each new exhibition season. Each number takes a single theme, such as territory or the body, and gathers essays and visual contributions from artists and researchers connected to the current shows. It suits readers following French contemporary art and the Palais de Tokyo programme.
